patch.summary:
Choose cPanel only if your buying job matches “Hosting control panel — Solo $29.99/mo (1 account); Admin $35.99 (≤5); Pro $53.99 (≤30); P” rather than SiteGround's shape. Choose SiteGround only if your buying job matches “Managed WordPress hosting with shared-plan packaging — StartUp promo $2.99 then renews $17” rather than cPanel's shape. Workflow advantage: cPanel leans hosting-operations; SiteGround leans hosting-providers. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
